meta_description:
721 likes, 14 comments - cosmoindia on October 30, 2026: "Living authentically means living by your inner values rather than external approval or societal expectations. Kubbra Sait (@kubbrasait) learnt this the hard way when she was very young. “I was very badly bullied for over two years in elementary school.” This is when her parents enrolled her in personality development classes where she met a teacher who changed her life. “My formative belief system was completely rewritten and that changed everything. My teacher would ask me, 'why do you get upset when someone calls you names? Are you that name? And if you are not then why are you allowing that to affect you?’” That sense of non-judgement was sown so deep into her being that even years later, if she ever goes off track, Sait always finds her way back. 

Read the interview at the link in bio!

Editor: Snigdha Ahuja (@snigdha.ahuja)
Interview: Karishma Upadhyay (@karishmaupadhyay)
Photographer: Sushant Chhabria (@sushantchhabria)
Stylist: Zoha Castelino (@zohacastelino)
Make-up Artist: Arleen Gonsalves (@arleen_gonsalves)
Hair Artist: Ishitaa Pahuja (@eetle.beetle)
Editorial Coordinator: Shalini Kanojia (@shalinikanojia)
Assistant Stylist: Aayushi Vaidya (@runwayrecess)
